title: Derived completeness after proper direct image
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-qcqs-compact-support-image-complete, the proper direct image of every derived-complete completed-coefficient complex on the compactification is derived complete.

source.place: Proper direct-image part of the completeness paragraph of the proper/open compact-support argument
source.note: Strictly smaller proper factor of the compact-support image completeness statement.

proof.text: The completed pullback map is defined as the inverse adjoint of sfCompletedCoefficientMap. The homEquiv apply_symm_apply identity therefore identifies the ordinary ringed direct image with sfCompletedModuleDirectImage. The rightDerivedFunctorNatIso construction consequently gives an isomorphism of their total right-derived functors.

Choose an auxiliary prime p different from l by infinitude of primes. Apply the existing completed-coefficient pushforward comparison to c.g to obtain its normalized ComparisonData; this does not add a hypothesis on the base field.

Apply the already proved completed_image_complete helper in SfCompleteDirectImageReduction to this ComparisonData and hM. It gives intrinsic completeness of the ordinary completed derived image, which is the requested image up to the preceding functor isomorphism. The existing complete_iso helper transports intrinsic completeness along its inverse. This is the completeness part of the existing arbitrary-morphism argument; properness and geometric bounds need no further proof here.

proof_origin: F6: reuse the proved completed_image_complete helper from SfCompleteDirectImageReduction, after identifying the ringed pushforward by the defining coefficient adjunction. Source: Stacks Tag 099N, lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case (1),(3),(4).
